close_reason: Won't fix: P3-opinion-only cosmetic docs.rs concern. The re-export chain (jmap-types::backend -> jmap-server::backend with error types added -> extension-server::backend) is the standard facade pattern. Adding #[doc(inline)] would change docs.rs presentation but is purely cosmetic. Per AGENTS.md convergence rule, P3/opinion is at bikeshedding threshold.
description:
JmapBackend, GetObject, JmapObject, QueryObject, SetObject are defined in jmap-types::backend, re-exported by jmap-server::backend (which adds error types and supertrait), then re-exported again by every extension server's backend module.

Consumers running cargo doc see the same names appear in 3 crates' rustdoc with no indication of which is canonical. This works (it's the standard facade pattern) but loses canonical-source signal.

Mitigation options:
1. Add `#[doc(inline)]` on the re-exports in extension server crates so docs.rs renders the actual definition (rather than a one-line redirect).
2. Add a `/// Re-exported from [`jmap_server::JmapBackend`].` comment on each.

Marked opinion — purely a cosmetic docs.rs concern.

jmap-server is the foundation server crate per workspace AGENTS.md; the extension server crates are greenfield siblings that follow the canonical jmap-mail-server template.
title: P3: JmapBackend supertrait re-exports from jmap-types appear in 3 crates (cosmetic)
